offering_description.value: Designs and makes payment and authentication technologies, including banknote validators, cash-handling and payment systems, and security features for currency and documents. Sells to retailers, vending and gaming operators, banks, central banks and government printers, mainly through direct sales and partners.

primary_products.value: banknote validators; payment systems; merchandising systems; authentication features; security paper

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, vending and gaming operators, banks, cash-handling firms; B2G: central banks and government currency printers

end_markets.value: retail; banking; vending; gaming; government currency

revenue_model.value: product sales: payment and validation equipment and security materials; service fees: maintenance, support and software services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds validators, payment systems and security paper, sold to operators and central banks; software / platform: software for payment and merchandising systems sold to operators

geography_served.value: global: customers across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: payment and merchandising technologies, security and authentication technologies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large retailers, operators and central banks; partners / resellers: integrators and resellers serving smaller customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: export controls and security certifications for currency-related technology, product safety and data rules

notes: Company was separated from Crane Co. in 2023, so segment details may have changed since my information.
